name: url
label: URL
help: Enter an API path relative to https://api.magichour.ai, such as /v1/account. Include the leading slash and version. Put query parameters in Query string. Full URLs, dot segments, percent escapes, backslashes, fragments and query strings in this field are not accepted.

name: body
label: Body
help: Enter the JSON request body required by the endpoint. Authorization is supplied by your connection. A generation request consumes Magic Hour credits.
